description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the file structure: daily logs go at `~/.openclaw/skills/adhd-daily-planner/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md`. Creates `2025-06-10.md` at the exact correct path.
2. Agent reads the brain dump and correctly identifies 'investor update email' as the ONE thing, placing it under `🎯 MUST HAPPEN` marked with `★` (and ONLY that one task in that lane).
3. Agent uses all five exact swim lane headers with their proprietary emoji (`🎯 MUST HAPPEN`, `🔥 HIGH ENERGY`, `💧 MEDIUM ENERGY`, `❄️ LOW ENERGY`, `🚫 NOT TODAY`).
4. Agent marks the payment webhook bug as a dread task using `💀`.
5. Agent applies migration symbols to yesterday's 2025-06-09.md: incomplete tasks get `>` (carry forward), 'file quarterly tax documents' gets ~~strikethrough~~ (dropped per brain dump note), 'plan team offsite' stays in NOT TODAY.
6. Agent captures the dopamine reward (20 min walk) in the plan.
7. Agent uses proprietary duration markers (`⚡`, `⏱️`, `🕐`, `⏳`) rather than plain text durations.
8. Agent places 'plan team offsite for August' in the `🚫 NOT TODAY` lane of today's log.
